test_framework: None configured (no test script in package.json)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run lint to verify zero lint errors. 2. Run npm run build to verify zero build errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. RIOT_API_KEY is not set in env (expired/missing). Node.js v22 available.
contribution_requirements: Zero lint errors, zero build errors, responsive Tailwind CSS, semantic HTML, Next.js App Router best practices.
key_patterns: API route in app/api/riot/route.ts uses RiotApiError class from lib/riot-api.ts. The riotFetch function throws RiotApiError with specific status codes. 401/403 from Riot API is caught and returns 503 with user-friendly message. Missing RIOT_API_KEY throws RiotApiError(500) with message 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured'.
directory_structure: app/ (Next.js app router), lib/ (utilities and API helpers), public/ (static assets)
